result.summary: Our patch is byte-for-byte equivalent to the official reference fix in both production files: it adds the identical `isInvalidPath` helper to SlingServletResolver, guards `resolveServletInternal` with it, and restructures `SlingScriptResolverImpl.findScript` to reject invalid paths before resolution. The only differences are a slightly longer Javadoc comment and an added unit test — no behavioral divergence. This closes the consecutive-dots traversal class (e.g. "...", "....") that ResourceUtil.normalize leaves intact, at the same trust boundaries the maintainers chose. Structural overlap is 1.0 and it covers all official fix files.
result.root_cause: Path segments of 3+ consecutive dots bypass ResourceUtil.normalize yet can be resolved as parent-directory references, letting untrusted paths traverse outside allowed execution paths at the resource-resolver sink.

dimensions.rationale: Adds the same isInvalidPath guard at both resolution entry points, rejecting any all-dots segment >2 chars, closing the class not just the payload.
dimensions.evidence: SlingServletResolver.isInvalidPath + guard at resolveServletInternal (line ~455); SlingScriptResolverImpl.findScript wraps resolution in !isInvalidPath(name)
dimensions.label: Vulnerability elimination

dimensions.rationale: Neutralizes the flaw at the path-validation boundary before getResource is reached, exactly mirroring the official strategy, rather than patching a downstream symptom.
dimensions.evidence: guard placed before charAt(0)=='/' dispatch in resolveServletInternal and before normalize/getResource in findScript
dimensions.label: Root cause vs symptom

dimensions.rationale: Both tainted entry paths (servlet resolution and script findScript, absolute + relative-search-path branches) are covered, matching every official production file.
dimensions.evidence: overlap covers_all_official=true; findScript both branches gated; resolveServletInternal early-returns null
dimensions.label: Completeness / variants

dimensions.rationale: Production code is semantically identical to the official fix, same mechanism, same locations, same progress-tracker log message.
dimensions.evidence: diff of SlingServletResolver.java and SlingScriptResolverImpl.java matches reference b54d4e6693 line-for-line
dimensions.label: Developer-intent alignment

dimensions.rationale: Code equals the upstream-shipped fix so legitimate paths (dots not forming an all-dot segment) are preserved, but the pipeline ran 0 regressions and the POV did not reproduce pre-patch, so execution is unverified.
dimensions.label: Functional correctness

dimensions.rationale: Pure O(n) single-pass string scan with no regex, no I/O, no state; no ReDoS/TOCTOU/crash risk (empty path returns false safely).
dimensions.evidence: isInvalidPath while-loop over path.length(); resolveServletInternal null-checks request before logging
dimensions.label: No new defects

dimensions.rationale: Tight, localized change confined to the two official files plus one added test; no unrelated edits.

dimensions.label: Minimality

dimensions.rationale: The isInvalidPath dot-counting is a blocklist rather than pure canonicalize-and-verify, but it is the maintainers' chosen defense-of-record layered on the existing normalize + isPathAllowed base-dir check, so combined it is sound.
dimensions.evidence: isPathAllowed(path, executionPaths) retained; isInvalidPath supplements normalize which misses >2-dot segments
dimensions.label: Mitigation soundness
